mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion can potentiate pramipexole's orthostatic hypotension and neurological effects, while pramipexole may increase renal salt wasting.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes, and renal function regularly; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and adequate hydration; adjust diuretic dose if hypotension or electrolyte abnormalities develop.
